Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain and stiffness.
The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the impact. Over the course of 18 office visits, the
patient received conservative management including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching program
instruction. Treatment duration was somewhat longer than typical for uncomplicated cervical and lumbar strain, and progress was
gradual. Physical examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, which support the
diagnosis of soft tissue injury. Neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and strength, was within normal limits. No
prior injury or treatment to the cervical or lumbar regions is documented in the patient's history. Billing records were reviewed
and show no duplicate or repeated charges for services rendered. Patient continues to report intermittent discomfort; further
reassessment is planned.

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
